purpose: Fix train/runtime contract, then continue selected T5 weights. No synthetic gold or human review. Existing demo unchanged.
data_policy: Retain only published prior training targets passing shared runtime checks plus structural/discourse eligibility. Quarantine conflicts, never relabel as copies. Exact train/eval exclusions.
dev: Aligned prior dev for loss; new96 input-hash-sampled dev without grammar/reference-quality selection. Flag compatibility after selection and retain failures as separate diagnostics.
selection: Evaluate initializer and each full epoch. Mean of two equal panel scores on compatible refs. Edited-reference output scored as identity unless it adds a shorter sentence; copy-reference scored as returned. Highest score then lowest loss. No test selection.
test: Up to96 unused official DeSSE test pairs after every prior selected/prepared source/full-target exclusion. Basic length/markup only, no quality filtering. Minimum32. Score once after training, development comparison and frozen decision. Reserved domain test unused.
